description: Self-contained fresh-generation briefs for selected photographs whose original prompt was an edit. These are reusable briefs, not claims about the original generation call. Other assets use their saved original generation prompt.

briefs.aromatic-anisic: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait photograph evoking aniseed sweets and fennel. Use pale-green feathery fennel fronds, recognisable elongated ridged fennel seeds and a few smooth ivory aniseed sweets, nested naturally in a broad softly receding bed of fennel foliage. Keep the important seed ridges and sweet edges visible within the central narrow strip of a tapered chart crop. Refined macro photography, soft daylight, smooth cool-green atmosphere and gentle highlights. Few large, interwoven cues with quiet foliage behind the future lettering. No beige tabletop, stone, fabric, paper, flat substrate, containers, lettering or diagram marks.
briefs.aromatic-mint-scent: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait macro photograph evoking peppermint and crisp white chewing gum. Rich living mint greens, cool daylight, natural depth, sharply resolved serrated mint edges, veins and fine droplets. A large hanging mint leaf around the middle should end in a recognisable pointed tip near 54% of source width; the leaf can extend beyond the narrow central crop, but its tip and serrations must survive it. Include a smaller mint sprig near the top. Lower in the image, show a generously sized hard white rectangular gum pillow nestled among mint leaves: its rounded corner and smooth curved edge should cross the central strip so it remains recognisable when partly cropped. Avoid making the gum a tiny complete object or a soft marshmallow. Use a few tactile cues, quieter botanical depth and restrained cold atmosphere. No table, containers, decorative props, lettering or graphic shapes.
briefs.wood-cedar: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait macro photograph of dry, freshly sharpened reddish Virginia cedar. Warm tan/red-brown grain in raking dry light. At about 56% of image height, centre one delicate paper-thin C-shaped pencil shaving: its opening, both ends and feathered rim should fit within the central 25% of source width. Add one or two modest pencil-thin curled slivers vertically below, within the central 20% width, with a trace of fine dry wood dust. Quiet finely fibred cedar material and softly receding warm depth in the top third. Few clear forms and open shadows. This should evoke aromatic pencil shavings, not bark, cinnamon or a heap of red mulch. No gloss, smoke, moisture, tools, floor, table, lettering or diagram shapes.
briefs.1-floral-note-77eb00c9a6ba9786: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait macro photograph evoking fresh rose petals and rosewater. Muted natural pinks, elegant cool-soft light and velvety matte petal texture with naturally blurred rose surroundings. A focused fresh rose bloom with a clear central spiral and open petals sits exactly on the central axis; its complete silhouette fits inside the central 22% of image width with soft background around its edges. A smaller loose petal below, also centred, has a single subtle clean rosewater sheen. These cues sit naturally in out-of-focus petal surfaces, never like cutout stickers. Restrained tactile colour and gently receding detail. No extra dominant flowers, droplets across the bloom, vase, bottles, table, plastic texture, lettering, border or diagram.
briefs.2-gourmand-descriptors-a5ca1ba555e528d1: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait photograph evoking a dry whisky barrel: close curved oak staves, dry wood pores, gentle toast colour and warm amber cellar light. A recognisable junction of one dark iron hoop, a stave seam and rounded barrel shoulder lies within the central 40–60% width at 60–82% image height. The barrel fills beyond the photograph edges rather than appearing as a tiny complete object. A second quieter hoop arc in the upper third reinforces the cask. Keep a warmly shaded quieter strip around 66–75% height for future lettering. Refined close photography with dry warmth and boozy oak atmosphere. No thick sap, resin drips, syrup pools, detached charcoal, drinking glasses, bottles, labels, words, tabletop, decorative props, smoke or wet gloss.
briefs.3-tobacco-descriptors-c7d4a9f66eb31925: Create a full-bleed 1:3 portrait macro photograph evoking dried grass and sweet warm hay after a meadow has been cut. Golden backlit grass seed heads in the upper half, sun-warmed straw colour, fine papery fibres, loosely folded narrow grass blades and fine split straw stalks. One graceful feathery meadow-grass seed head curves into the central 40–60% width at about 60% image height. Its branching tips and slender stems may extend beyond the narrow chart crop; keep them generously sized and recognisable. Leave the central 70–80% height region quieter with softly resolved straw for future lettering. Warm restrained light and intimate natural depth. No broad tobacco-like or autumn leaves, twine, table, cloth, containers, smoke, moisture, lettering or diagram marks.
